notes.title: Update v1.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We have uploaded version 1.2 of Evemnesis! The update contains several changes (from stability issues to different audio effects). However, the most important improvement is the new User Interface and Writing Artifact, now you can write inside the main stages of the game from the start of the story!

To enable/disable the new User Interface, press the 'Esc' key (make sure to try all the available options).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33315491/3338a7f3aa869ce3e5b76f650cd90b3380aba3ff.jpg[/img]

The new Writing Artifact can be activated by using the [ - ] symbol on the User Interface. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33315491/2b7a0950276b4fdcd4396803fcd631ad3faf9aa3.jpg[/img]

Explore the Writing Artifact to discover new ways to interact with your writing and, most importantly, to create an image you'd want to share!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33315491/f63a0dbdc8dbf386e57f031af08b0e92f60ae5e6.jpg[/img]

In addition to these changes, we have included several hidden areas in the game that will trigger a special effect that will motivate you to write (and to pay attention to certain objects).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33315491/8a26b49f992f988f39269f8c9ff234a4e06810b3.jpg[/img]

Let us know if you find any issues with the update and don't forget to check out the updated Manual if you need more information.

Best regards.

notes.title: Update v1.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We have updated Evemnesis! The new version is 1.1. Here are the main changes:

The game now loads directly into the main screen and you can see the version of the game on the lower left corner.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33315491/135f1d54a471311b98f836e76a944430cb66f557.jpg[/img]

The story at the beginning of the game no longer advances on its own. We have included a “next” button to give more control to the player (you can take any time you want to read the dialogue).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33315491/8fcec6058e4b03d9137bca5ccbbaa4ca4144355d.jpg[/img]

Lastly, we added the same type of dialogue-control described above to another section of the game. We will not give you specifics in case you haven't discovered that area. Hint:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33315491/93900dbce472ae3eb4826e5605499c9b3b8f4791.jpg[/img]

Most of the fixes in the update are related to parts of the game where the player had to wait a couple of seconds to watch a brief cutscene or read dialogue. Some computers were taking more time than usual to execute the required actions. With version 1.1 we hope to create a more uniform experience across platforms.

Please let us know if you encounter any issues with the update! Write a comment here, post on the Community Hub or write us at support@cloudscapegt.com

Best regards.
